subject: an abstract gymnast made solely from a broad ribbon
pose: folded into a compact aerial tuck
art_direction: 一条橙色缎带结成抽象体操姿态，青色反面与深紫底形成优雅弹性，完全非人体结构。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Fold one broad satin ribbon into an abstract gymnast performing a compact aerial tuck. The form must remain visibly ribbon, with no human head, hands, or anatomical body parts. Use orange on the outer face and turquoise on the reverse, allowing the folds to reveal alternating colors. One small loop above the main knot hints at a lifted head-like gesture without becoming a person. Render the satin sheen along the tension lines and keep the edges crisp. Suspend the sculpture against a deep violet background with a soft light from above. The knot fills the central three quarters of the square, with all ribbon ends curled inward for a circular avatar crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
